story: In the diverse world of birds, the Eurasian Hobby (Falco subbuteo) stands out. This species, part of the Falconidae family, is a resident of Open woodland; parks; agricultural country; downlands; heaths; and areas near water. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Eurasian Hobby is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Eurasian Hobby and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
